title: Count Words in a Sentence
statement:
Given a sentence S, count the number of words in it.

Words are separated by one or more spaces. There may be leading or trailing spaces. A word is a maximal sequence of non-space characters.
constraints:
1 <= |S| <= 10^4
S contains only printable ASCII characters.
inputFormat: A single line containing the sentence S.
outputFormat: A single integer: the number of words in S.

examples.explanation: Leading/trailing spaces and multiple spaces are ignored; 4 words.
